questions.question: In Capernaum, a house was packed with people. How did four men get a paralyzed man to Jesus?

answers.text: Opened the roof and lowered him down on his mat
Waited outside until the whole crowd went home
Shouted over the crowd for Jesus to come out

questions.question: When four men lowered a paralyzed man through a roof to Jesus, what did Jesus say to him first?

answers.text: Son go show yourself to the priest
Son your faith has healed you

questions.question: When Jesus told a paralyzed man his sins were forgiven, what were the scribes sitting nearby thinking?

answers.text: He is blaspheming since only God can forgive sins
He should not be teaching on the Sabbath
He should have healed the man before anything else

questions.question: Before telling a paralyzed man to get up, Jesus gave the scribes a reason. What was it?

answers.text: So they know He has authority to forgive sins
So they know He is a prophet like Elijah
So they know God has heard the man's prayers
